_note: Keys are the EXACT source literals from src/client (spaces included) and are replaced at build time by scripts/i18n.mjs. Keys are the Chinese text so that upstream's diff is the dictionary: a changed upstream string stops matching and the build fails closed, pointing here. Do not edit src/ -- see FORK.md. `node scripts/i18n.mjs report` lists untranslated and stale entries.

strings.读取片库失败：: Could not load the intro library:
strings.还没有打开的会话：先打开一个对话，才能只对它生效: No conversation is open yet: open one first to scope the intro to it
strings.视频加载超时: The video took too long to load
strings.视频加载失败 —— 控制台有 [dsh-boot-animation] 日志: The video failed to load — see the [dsh-boot-animation] logs in the console
strings.「▶ 预览」立刻播这一段（不改你的选择）；「选它」设为全局片头；「仅本会话」只让: “▶ Preview” plays this one right now without changing your choice. “Choose” makes it the global intro. “This chat only” plays it for this chat alone.
strings.本会话跟随全局片头。想只给这个会话换一段，点那一行的「仅本会话」。: This chat follows the global intro. To give this chat one of its own, use “This chat only” on that row.
strings.还没有打开的会话：先打开一个对话，才能只对它生效。: No conversation is open yet: open one first to scope the intro to it.
strings.取消这个会话的固定片头，回到全局选择: Clear this chat's intro pin and go back to the global choice
strings.份相同的副本，已合并成一条。你的文件没有被删，只是不重复列出。: identical copies of this on disk, merged into a single entry. None of your files were deleted — they are just not listed twice.
strings.这个文件的索引表(moov)在末尾：浏览器要整段下载完才出画面，容易黑屏。用 f: This file's index (moov) sits at the end, so the browser has to download the whole thing before any picture appears, which tends to mean a black screen. Reorder it once with: ffmpeg -c copy -movflags +faststart
strings.立刻播放这一段，不改变你的选择: Play this one right now, without changing your choice
strings.设为以后开片头时播放的片段: Use this as the intro from now on
strings.只让当前这个会话播这一段 —— 不改你给其它会话和全局选的那一段: Play this one for this chat only — without changing what you picked for other chats or globally
strings.先打开一个对话，才能只对它生效: Open a conversation first to scope the intro to it
strings.想加自己的片子：把 mp4 放进这个文件夹，再点「刷新」: To add your own: drop an mp4 into this folder, then press “Refresh”
strings.铺满整个窗口，超出部分裁掉 —— 不留黑边: Fill the whole window and crop the overflow — no black bars
strings.完整显示整帧，长宽比不匹配时留黑边: Show the entire frame, with black bars when the aspect ratio does not match
strings.每次开片头时，从所有可播放的片段里随机挑一段（连续两次不会挑到同一段）: For each intro, pick one playable clip at random (never the same one twice in a row)
strings.立刻按当前设置播一次（随机开启时就是从全部片段里随机挑一段）: Play once right now with the current settings (a random pick from every clip while random is on)
strings.已把这个会话设为片头会话: This chat is now pinned as an intro chat
strings.这个会话已设为片头会话：每次打开都会播放片头动画（点击取消）: This chat is pinned as an intro chat: the intro plays every time you open it (click to unpin)
strings.把这个会话设为片头会话：以后每次打开它都会播放片头动画: Pin this chat as an intro chat: the intro plays every time you open it
strings.片头片库：查看、预览、切换或添加片头视频: Intro library: review, preview, switch or add intro videos
